verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official SDK: all v3 functionality comes through the `@trigger.dev/sdk` module, which handles triggering and managing tasks and listing runs via the management API. Users report that some docs and examples still show deprecated v3 code after the v4 release. Python appears only as a runtime build extension, not as a client SDK. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond TypeScript/JavaScript, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and docs kept fully in sync across major versions.
